_comment_top: WhatsApp -> Telegram and Signal. Save as configs/wa-<short_id>.json and start with ./forwarder.sh start wa-<short_id>.
_comment_attribution: File-wide default: prefix messages with the sender's WhatsApp profile name. Pairs can override.
_comment_alerts: Optional: Telegram user id the bot DMs when the bridge needs attention. Press Start on the bot once.

pairs._comment: A WhatsApp group (id from ./forwarder.sh wa-groups <short_id>) -> a Telegram supergroup and a Signal group. Signal group ids come from signal-cli-rest-api's /v1/groups/<SIGNAL_SENDER> (README §12, Signal destinations); a +phone number sends to a 1:1 chat.
A 1:1 WhatsApp chat -> a topic of a Telegram forum supergroup, without sender names.
